coverage_map.title: Python for ML engineering
coverage_map.mds_timing: B1 Sep-Oct; B2 Oct-Nov; B3 Nov-Dec; B4 Jan
coverage_map.notes: MDS teaches basic Python, pandas (not Polars/DuckDB), unit tests, Make/Docker. Hyperscale: NumPy vectorization/broadcasting/perf, typing, pytest, uv, Polars, DuckDB.

coverage_map.title: Linear algebra
coverage_map.notes: Only matrix notation for regression and PCA use; no SVD/eigen theory.

coverage_map.title: Calculus & optimization
coverage_map.notes: 572 covers GD/SGD and float error applied; add convexity, second-order methods, constrained optimization. Learner's calculus is strong.

coverage_map.title: Probability & statistics
coverage_map.notes: Heavy frequentist and Bayesian coverage in R. Diagnostic plus Python equivalents (scipy, statsmodels, bootstrap in NumPy); add MLE/asymptotics if missing.

coverage_map.title: Information theory
coverage_map.notes: Entropy appears only implicitly in trees.

coverage_map.title: Linear/logistic regression, regularization, bias-variance
coverage_map.notes: Covered as inference (R) and applied sklearn. Add from-scratch GD, closed form, probabilistic derivations. Python equivalent of R GLM material.

coverage_map.title: Model evaluation
coverage_map.notes: Metrics, CV, imbalance, SHAP covered. Add calibration, leakage case studies, grouped/time-series CV.

coverage_map.title: Trees, forests, boosting
coverage_map.notes: Trees and RF applied; boosting internals (XGBoost/LightGBM) mostly absent.

coverage_map.title: SVMs, kernels, kNN
coverage_map.notes: Applied usage; add kernel math and dual form briefly.

coverage_map.title: Unsupervised learning
coverage_map.notes: k-means, GMM/EM, PCA, NMF, hierarchical, topic models, recsys. Targeted extensions: t-SNE/UMAP, EM from scratch.

coverage_map.title: Feature engineering & data pipelines
coverage_map.notes: sklearn pipelines and feature work; add production pipelines, Polars/DuckDB, leakage-safe design.

coverage_map.title: Autograd from scratch
coverage_map.notes: Backprop is conceptual; no engine built.

coverage_map.title: Training deep nets
coverage_map.notes: Basic training recipes only; add init, normalization, schedules, debugging.

coverage_map.title: PyTorch fluency
coverage_map.notes: Basic PyTorch; add GPU, AMP, custom modules/data loaders.

coverage_map.title: CNNs, RNNs/LSTMs, attention
coverage_map.notes: Conceptual/applied; add from-scratch implementations.

coverage_map.title: Transformers from scratch
coverage_map.notes: One-two lectures, applied.

coverage_map.title: Pretraining, scaling laws, fine-tuning, RLHF
coverage_map.notes: LLM overview only.

coverage_map.title: Building with LLMs
coverage_map.notes: No RAG/agents/MCP expected; confirm with 2026-27 syllabus.

coverage_map.title: Generative models
coverage_map.notes: No VAEs/diffusion.

coverage_map.title: Time series
coverage_map.notes: ARIMA, state space, HMMs, GPs. Add GBM and DL forecasters, probabilistic forecasting, backtesting. Check whether 574 is R or Python.

coverage_map.title: Anomaly detection & fault diagnosis
coverage_map.notes: Change-point detection only.

coverage_map.title: Optimization & control
coverage_map.notes: Only discrete optimization/DP.

coverage_map.title: Bayesian methods & UQ
coverage_map.notes: Stan in R; give PyMC/NumPyro equivalents; add conformal prediction, ensembles, calibration.

coverage_map.title: Causal inference
coverage_map.notes: Frequentist/regression in R; add DAGs, potential outcomes, DoWhy/EconML in Python.

coverage_map.title: ML system design
coverage_map.notes: Interview-style design not covered.

coverage_map.title: MLOps
coverage_map.notes: Docker, Make, CI, intro cloud (EC2); add tracking, serving, monitoring, AWS/Azure ML.

coverage_map.title: Scaling & distributed training
coverage_map.notes: Intro parallel computing only.

coverage_map.title: Responsible AI
coverage_map.notes: Privacy/ethics/security; add fairness, model risk.
